ai.title: Reduce opengraph image size
ai.summary: The `web/public/opengraph-image.png` binary was updated with a smaller size. This adjustment optimizes the asset for preview rendering. The change is scoped to the web public directory. No other files were modified.

eli5.text: The preview image that shows up when someone shares a link to the site has been made smaller in file size. This means the picture loads faster when people see link previews on social media or messaging apps. The change only affects the main preview image and nothing else about the site.

ai.title: Remove MAXITERATIONS hard stop in agent mode
ai.summary: Agent loop in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts` no longer exits on `MAX_ITERATIONS` via `while` condition. Instead, hitting the limit triggers a synthetic `continue` tool call when `allowUnboundedIteration` is true and no real tool call exists. This prevents premature termination of long-running tasks while preserving the warning log. Internal loop logic only; no CLI or Web UI changes.

eli5.text: When the assistant is working on a task in agent mode and hits the built-in iteration cap, it no longer just stops. Instead of giving up, it now fakes a 'continue' command so the task can keep running as long as needed. This only affects the internal agent loop logic, so you wouldn't see anything differently in the app itself, but your long-running tasks won't get cut off anymore.

ai.title: Add sponsee referral tracking and display
ai.summary: Implemented sponsee referral tracking via new /{sponsee} routing page and updated Banner component. New page validates routing keys against sponseeConfig, stores search params, and redirects to home with utm_source=youtube. Banner displays personalized referral messages for YouTube-sourced users using display names from sponseeConfig. Referrals page now maps routing keys to referral codes and display names. Navbar hides Referrals link for unauthenticated users.

eli5.text: When someone clicks a referral link from a YouTube creator, the site now recognizes who sent them and shows a personalized welcome message with you's name and any bonus they might get. A new landing page checks the link's address to verify it's from a real partner, saves the tracking info, and then sends the visitor to the main page with special tracking tags. The navigation bar no longer shows the Referrals link unless you're logged in. This works today for visitors coming from YouTube creator referrals.

ai.title: Remove unused imports in web/src/app/layout.tsx
ai.summary: Removed unused `useEffect` and `useSearchParams` imports from `web/src/app/layout.tsx`. This cleanup resolves linting warnings and reduces bundle size by eliminating dead code dependencies. The change is scoped to the web layout component.

eli5.text: The web page layout stopped loading two helper tools it was importing but never actually using. If you looked at the page today, nothing visible changed, no layout shifts, no new features, but the page loads slightly faster because it no longer downloads code that was sitting unused in the background. This is behind-the-scenes cleanup that tidy developers do to keep websites quick and lean.

ai.title: Add cleanMarkdownCodeBlock tests
ai.summary: Added unit tests for `cleanMarkdownCodeBlock` in `test/__src__/process-file-block.test.ts`. Verifies removal of markdown code block syntax with and without language tags, multiline handling, and passthrough for non-block content. Renamed existing suite to `parseAndGetDiffBlocksSingleFile`. Scope limited to test file; no production code changes.

eli5.text: Behind the scenes, the team added extra checks to make sure the assistant correctly strips out code-formatting markers when it processes code snippets you paste, so text like '```typescript' wrappers get removed properly whether or not they include a language label. These are hidden safeguards, not something you'd see on screen, but they help prevent confusing or broken code blocks from appearing in shared patches. No visible features changed; this only affects how the system validates code handling internally. The change is live today and only impacts the engineering system, not your experience directly.

ai.title: Wrap Banner in Suspense for useSearchParams
ai.summary: Wrapped Banner component in Suspense boundary. useSearchParams hook requires client-side rendering context in Next.js App Router. Fixes potential build/runtime errors related to missing suspense boundary. Affects web/src/components/ui/banner.tsx.

eli5.text: The promotional banner at the top of the page used to break the site's loading process. Now it loads safely without causing errors. If you looked at the site, the banner would appear normally instead of possibly not showing up at all. This fix is live today.

ai.title: Fix referral page to show sponsee name
ai.summary: The referral redemption page now displays the sponsee's name instead of their GitHub handle when a valid referral code is provided. This change introduces a derived `sponsees` array in `web/src/lib/constant.ts` and updates `web/src/app/referrals/[code]/page.tsx` to lookup names via this array rather than direct config access. The fix ensures user-friendly naming across the web referral interface.

eli5.text: When someone uses your referral link to sign up, they will now see your actual name displayed on the confirmation page instead of a technical nickname. This makes it clear to new users which person referred them. The site now looks up your real name using a simple list that matches your referral code.
